candidates.term: The General inside the Day Gate
candidates.defline: The General sits in your spouse palace: love, for you, has a chain of command to dismantle.
candidates.reading: This position rules Love and Health. Intimacy arrives armored: you protect fiercely, provoke instinctively, and test partners for spine before trusting them with softness. Passion runs high voltage here, and so do battles. The work of your romantic life is learning that home is not terrain. A partner is not a lieutenant, and surrender, occasionally, is not defeat. Choose someone unafraid of you. Then prove them right slowly.
candidates.teaser: You are drawn to intensity at close range: a partner with force, a home with weather. Love holds when the two of you aim the pressure outward together.
